{{Quote|&laquo;The Loyalist Committee has arrived, Your Honor.''&raquo;<br />"''Good.''"<br />[Dar Wac contiues to speak in an alien language]<br />"''Send them in.|Dar Wac announces the arrival of the Loyalist Committee to Palpatine|quotestart=0|audio=DarWac-AOTC.flac|<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Dar Wac''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] who served [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] as [[Executive Administrator]] in the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]].

==Biography==
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Dar Wac served as liaison between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. He worked at a desk in the lobby that led to the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's suite]]. Just before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] Dar Wac was seen in a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] when he announced the arrival of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]].

Following the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]], the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] investigated whether he was involved in the scheming of [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Ronet Coorr]] and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], although nothing was found.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dar Wac first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of the film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] by [[R. A. Salvatore]],<ref name="AOTCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> released on [[April 23]], [[2002]], and then in the film itself on [[May 16]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Concept art<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> and the [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|illustrated screenplay]] of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] show that a scene in which Wac and two members of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] attempt to stop [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and his team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] reaching [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] before being [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pushed]] into the walls by the Jedi was planned;<ref name="Screenplay">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> however, it did not make it into the final film.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>
